يستسهلا (form X)
# يَسْتَسْهِلَا (yastashilā) /jas.tas.hi.laː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَسْهَلَ (istashala)
# يُسْتَسْهَلَا (yustashalā) /jus.tas.ha.laː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَسْهَلَ (istashala)
